title: Keybind Chest Looter
description: A lightweight client-side mod that adds a customizable hotkey for quickly transferring items from chests into your inventory.
body:
# Keybind Chest Looter

A lightweight client-side mod that adds a customizable hotkey for quickly transferring items from chests into your inventory.

# Features

- Adds a new keybind in Minecraft controls.
- Instantly transfers all items from an opened chest to your inventory.
- Fully customizable keybind.
- Works with any standard container or loot chest.
- Lightweight and easy to use.
- Client-side only.

# How to Use

1. Install the mod.
1. Open Options → Controls and set your preferred keybind.
1. Open a chest containing items.
1. Press your configured hotkey.
1. All available items will be transferred to your inventory automatically.

# Notes
- Requires enough free inventory space.
- Only affects your own inventory.
- Designed for faster looting and quality-of-life gameplay.
